title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity



Legacy Property Buyers is a fast-growing real estate investment company that specializes in helping homeowners sell their properties through creative solutions, including cash purchases, wholesale deals, and novations.



We are hiring a Full-Time Transaction Coordinator to help manage our real estate deals from contract to closing.



This is not a basic admin role. This is not a “just update a spreadsheet and wait for instructions” position. You will be responsible for helping keep deals organized, moving, documented, and on track while communicating with title companies, agents, lenders, buyers, internal tea
mbers, and other parties involved in the transaction.



If you are looking for an easy remote job where you can move slowly, wait to be told everything, or avoid pressure, this is not it.



If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, excellent at communication, and able to keep multiple deals moving without constant supervision, keep reading.



We are looking for someone who can work EST business hours, communicate in excellent English, move quickly, follow up aggressively, and take ownership of the closing process.



Compensation:

Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and real estate transaction coordination background.



Expected compensation may include:

Monthly base pay

Closed deal bonus

Accuracy/performance bonus



This role is full-time and long-term. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, become a key part of our operations, and help us close deals faster and more consistently.



This is a role where strong operators are rewarded for accuracy, ownership, and consistency.



What You’ll Own:

Your job is to help manage real estate transactions from contract to closing and make sure every deal is organized, updated, followed up on, and moving forward.



You will own the operational side of the deal process, including title coordination, document tracking, deadline management, transaction updates, closing checklists, buyer/seller file organization, and internal communication.



Your performance will be measured by your ability to:

Keep deals moving toward closing

Follow up with title companies, agents, lenders, and buyers

Maintain accurate transaction records

Track missing documents and deadlines

Communicate clearly with the internal team

Catch issues early before they become fires

Keep Podio, Slack, Google Drive, and deal records updated

Help reduce the workload from our Dispositions Manager

Maintain a high level of accuracy without needing to be babysat



This role is about ownership, speed, accuracy, and communication.



Core Responsibilities

1. Transaction Coordination + Deal Management

You will help manage active deals once they are under contract and assist with moving them toward closing.



You will be responsible for:

Opening title when needed

Confirming title has received the correct documents

Tracking title company contact information

Tracking escrow officer information

Monitoring earnest money deposit status

Tracking buyer and seller documents

Tracking closing dates and key deadlines

Following up with title companies for updates

Confirming payoffs, liens, taxes, judgments, and title issues are being handled

Updating the internal team on transaction progress

Keeping every active deal organized and moving forward



You must be comfortable following up with people repeatedly and professionally until the task is complete.



This is not a passive role. You are expected to push deals forward.



2. Title Company, Agent, Buyer, and Lender Communication

You will communicate with different parties involved in real estate transactions.



You will be responsible for:

ing and calling title companies for updates

Coordinating with real estate agents on novation/listing deals

Following up with buyers and buyer agents when needed

Tracking lender timelines when a buyer is using financing

Confirming inspections, appraisals, and closing requirements

Requesting missing documents

Sending reminders before deadlines

Escalating issues to the Dispositions Manager when needed



You do not need to be aggressive or rude, but you do need to be confident, clear, and persistent.



If someone is delaying the deal, we need to know quickly.



3. Documentation + File Accuracy



Every deal must be clean, organized, and accurate.



You will be responsible for:

Uploading documents to the correct deal file

Naming documents clearly

Confirming documents match the correct property

Tracking purchase agreements, novation agreements, amendments, buyer contracts, EMD receipts, listing documents, closing statements, and other deal paperwork

Making sure Google Drive and Podio are updated

Verifying important information before marking tasks complete

Catching missing or incorrect information



Accuracy matters.



A wrong price, wrong closing date, wrong buyer name, wrong seller name, or wrong document can create serious problems.



The standard is simple:



If it is not accurate, it is not complete.



4. Closing Checklist + Deadline Management

You will help maintain the closing checklist for every active transaction.



You will be responsible for tracking:

Contract date

Closing date

Title company

Escrow officer

Buyer information

Seller information

EMD status

Missing documents

Payoff status

Title issues

Inspection/appraisal timeline

Financing status

Settlement statement status

Final closing confirmation



You should always know:

What is the current status of the deal?

What is missing?

Who owes us something?

What is the next step?

Is the deal at risk?

Does Chris need to step in?



Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



5. Internal Communication + Updates

We are a remote team, so clear communication is required.



You will be responsible for:

Posting clear deal updates in Slack

Updating Podio accurately

Communicating blockers early

Asking for clarification when information is unclear

Keeping the Dispositions Manager updated

Sending daily or weekly transaction status reports

Making sure every deal has a clear next action



No vague updates.

Bad update:



“Waiting on title.”

Good update:



“Title confirmed they received the contract. They are waiting on the seller payoff authorization. I
ed the seller at 10:15am and followed up with title at 12:30pm. Next step: follow up again tomorrow morning if not received.”



We need clear communication that tells the team exactly where things stand.



6. Escalation + Problem Spotting

You are not expected to solve every high-level issue by yourself, but you are expected to spot problems early.



You will be responsible for escalating when:

Title is not responding

Seller documents are missing

Buyer EMD has not been deposited

Closing date is at risk

A lien, judgment, tax issue, or payoff problem appears

The settlement statement does not show our expected payout

Buyer financing is delayed

Realtor/agent communication becomes unclear

Seller or buyer behavior creates risk

A deal may not close on time



The worst thing you can do is stay quiet while a deal slowly falls apart.



If something looks off, speak up early.



Necessary Skills

You need to be strong in the following areas:

Excellent English communication, written and verbal

Strong attention to detail

Organization

Follow-up discipline

Speed of execution

Calendar and deadline management

Professional
 communication

Phone confidence

Problem-solving

Ability to manage multiple deals at once

Ability to work independently

Ability to stay calm under pressure

High ownership

Accuracy with numbers, names, dates, and documents

Comfort using CRMs and online systems

Ability to ask questions instead of guessing

Strong internet research skills

Coachability



You do not need to know everything about wholesale and novation real estate deals on day one, but you do need to be sharp, detail-oriented, proactive, and willing to learn quickly.



Who This Role Is For:

You will likely thrive here if you are:

Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Proactive

Comfortable following up with people repeatedly

Strong in written English

Confident enough to call title companies, agents, buyers, and lenders

Looking for a long-term role with a growing company



This is a good fit for someone who enjoys operations, organization, communication, and making sure deals get completed correctly.



Who This Role Is NOT For

You need constant supervision to stay productive

This role is remote, but it is not relaxed.



Deals move fast. Deadlines matter. Accuracy matters.



Requirements & Non-Negotiables:

Excellent fluent English communication, written and verbal

Reliable computer

High-speed internet

Quiet work environment

Full-time availability

, phone, and Slack

Comfortable using online systems, CRMs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and

Preferred But Not Required

Experience with novation/listing transactions

Experience with Podio

Experience with real estate documents and closing statements

Our Standards & Values



This is a performance culture. We value:



Competitive Greatness

Unimpeachable Character

Sincere Candor



If you avoid accountability, move slowly, or need constant reminders, this will not be a fit.



If you are organized, proactive, detail-oriented, coachable, and able to keep deals moving, you will have a serious opportunity here.



We are a small team, so every person matters.



What You’ll Get

100% remote work

Full-time long-term opportunity

Real estate transaction coordination training

Experience with wholesale and novation deal structures

Direct access to leadership

Opportunity to grow with the company

Performance-based bonus potential

A clear role with real responsibility

A young, aggressive, growth-minded team

A position where accuracy, speed, and ownership are recognized



You will learn how real estate investment transactions move from contract to closing and become a key part of helping the company close more deals.



How to Apply



When you apply, include the following:

Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



Job Details



Job Type: Full-time

Role Type: Transaction Coordination / Real Estate Operations



Final Note



This is an important operations role inside a fast-moving real estate investment company.



You will be expected to follow up, communicate clearly, keep files accurate, update systems, track deadlines, and help make sure deals close.



If you want an easy admin job, this is not the right fit.



If you are organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and want to become a key part of a growing real estate company, we want to hear from you.

title: SEO Manager
description:
About Rocket Clicks







At Rocket Clicks, we help Family Law Firms grow through focused, performance-driven digital marketing.







We are not a generalist agency. We are building the definitive growth partner for family law firms by combining deep marketing expertise, real law firm operating experience, and a disciplined approach to execution.



Our team thrives on solving hard problems, improving client performance, and building trusted long-term relationships. We care about results, and we also care about how the work gets done.







Our culture is rooted in six core values:



Proactive – We anticipate opportunities and act before problems arise.

Disciplined – We remain focused and committed to excellence.

Candid – We communicate clearly and directly.

Empathetic – We understand and respect the perspectives of others.

Accountable – We take ownership of results, good or bad.

Results-Oriented – We focus on outcomes, not busyness.

If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home at Rocket Clicks!







The Ideal Candidate



You are a well-rounded SEO who can handle every part of the discipline, with particular strength in technical SEO and AI-assisted execution. You can run audits across on-page, content, internal linking, and local SEO, but the work that comes most naturally to you is the technical layer: crawl behavior, indexation, HTML structure, schema, and site architecture.







You work independently. When a ranking drops, an indexation issue surfaces, or a site behaves in a way no one can explain, you investigate it, find the root cause, and put together a fix. You read source code when you need to. You inspect crawl data and check rendered output. You do not need a checklist to know where to start.







You are also fluent with modern AI tools. You use them every day, and you build workflows, prompts, and custom skills that other people on the team can run. You know where AI accelerates the work and where it produces output that is not usable.







You can execute, review other people's work, and mentor SEO Specialists. This role is technical and operational. Strategy is owned by the Director of SEO.







If you want to do strong, well-rounded SEO with technical depth and AI fluency at the center of it, this is a fit.







POSITION SUMMARY



The Associate SEO Lead is the senior execution and quality role on the Rocket Clicks SEO team.







Reporting to the Director of SEO, this role is responsible for SEO execution across all assigned client accounts, with particular ownership of technical SEO, crawl and indexation analysis, HTML and site structure review, AI workflow development, quality control of deliverables, and direct mentorship of SEO Specialists.







This is a step above the SEO Specialist role. The Associate SEO Lead is responsible for making sure the work is correct across every layer of SEO, that technical implementation is clean, that deliverables are accurate, and that the team's AI-assisted processes improve over time.







Required: Proficiency across all aspects of SEO, advanced technical SEO expertise, fluency with AI tools and AI workflow design, and the ability to diagnose problems independently.







Pay range monthly: USD 1,800 - 2,500 per month

Location: Remote-Philippines (100% Work From Home)

Work Schedule: 8AM to 5PM Central Standard Time

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (40 hours/week)





Key Responsibilities & Objectives



Technical SEO Execution

Conduct advanced technical audits across crawlability, indexation, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, schema, page speed, redirects, canonicalization, hreflang, and core site health.

Review and refine HTML semantics across client sites, including heading hierarchy, semantic tag usage, structured data implementation, accessibility-aware markup, and on-page elements that influence ranking and parsing.

Diagnose ranking declines, indexation drops, traffic anomalies, render issues, and crawl inefficiencies. Trace symptoms to root cause.

Lead crawl analysis using Screaming Frog, log file review, rendered DOM inspection, and equivalent tools. Identify crawl traps, orphaned pages, parameter bloat, redirect chains, and wasted crawl budget.

Own local SEO technical execution, including Google Business Profile optimization, location page structure, citation hygiene, review surfacing, proximity-related signals, and technical implementation of local schema.

Translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, designers, content writers, and account teams.

Review the implementation of SEO recommendations end-to-end. Verify that what shipped matches what was specified.

Stay current on algorithm updates, AI search surfaces, rendering behavior changes, structured data evolution, and emerging technical SEO standards.

Content Development & Structure

Direct content production by writing briefs and outlines that specify search intent, target keywords, primary entities, supporting subtopics, required sections, and internal linking targets.

Structure on-page content using proper semantic HTML, heading hierarchy, and content flow that reinforces topical relevance and supports both readers and search engines.

Map content into the right place in site architecture, including hub-and-spoke relationships, cluster pages, and supporting articles, so each piece earns its placement.

Build internal linking patterns that pass authority where it is needed, connect related entities, and reinforce topical clusters.

Review and optimize existing content for search intent alignment, semantic depth, structural improvements, and internal linking opportunities.

Identify content gaps based on keyword coverage, search intent, competitor presence, and topical authority needs.

Surface and elevate underperforming or buried content that should be restructured, repurposed, or linked to from higher-authority pages.

Review content before publish for SEO alignment, structural soundness, on-page optimization, and adherence to internal linking standards.

Partner with content writers and editors to ensure published work matches the brief, the search intent, and the site architecture it lives within.

AI Workflow Development & Process Engineering

Design, build, and refine AI-assisted workflows that accelerate SEO research, audit production, content review, technical analysis, reporting, and documentation.

Develop reusable AI prompts, skills, and standard operating procedures that the SEO team can run repeatedly with consistent quality.

Identify high-friction, high-volume tasks across the SEO discipline and replace manual repetition with reliable AI execution paths.

Test new AI tools, model versions, and integrations. Validate output quality before rolling anything out to the broader team.

Document AI workflows so they are transferable, auditable, and improvable by anyone on the team.

Use AI to accelerate work without producing unreviewed or generic output. Maintain human review on anything client-facing.

Performance Diagnosis & Reporting

Monitor organic KPIs across assigned accounts, including visibility, rankings, traffic, leads, conversion rate, and local search performance.

Diagnose what is changing and why. Pull the technical, on-page, link, and crawl signals that explain the movement.

Identify patterns across accounts and surface technical or executional fixes that can be rolled out broadly.

Conduct competitive technical and on-page analysis to understand what is structurally different between winning and losing pages in a given market.

Improve the clarity of SEO reporting so both clients and internal teams understand what changed, why it changed, and what action is being taken.

Quality Control & Team Support

 Review SEO deliverables for technical accuracy, structural soundness, implementation quality, and client readiness.

Mentor SEO Specialists on technical execution, crawl analysis, problem diagnosis, AI tool use, and clear communication.

Help define sprint priorities at the execution level by estimating effort, identifying dependencies, and flagging technical risk.

Serve as the technical escalation point for complex SEO issues across the team.

Contribute to documentation, templates, checklists, QA processes, AI workflow libraries, and internal training resources.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Execution

Work closely with Account Managers to ensure technical findings and execution outcomes are translated cleanly to clients.

Partner with content teams to ensure on-page and technical implementation supports the content and the search environment it lives in.

Collaborate with designers and developers to verify that SEO recommendations are scoped, implemented, and QA'd correctly.

Participate in internal discussions and contribute technical insight from client accounts.

Strengthen the feedback loop between execution, QA, reporting, and client-facing communication.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Test new SEO tools, technical workflows, and AI processes that improve speed, accuracy, or output quality.

Help Rocket Clicks strengthen its family law SEO execution playbook through testing, documentation, and shared findings.

Identify responsible, high-leverage uses of generative AI in SEO research, audit work, content review, and analysis.

Share findings, prompts, workflows, and lessons with the broader team so the team improves over time.

Success Metrics (KPIs)



Technical Execution Quality: Assigned accounts show measurable improvement in technical health, crawl efficiency, indexation, on-page integrity, and local search performance.

Diagnostic Accuracy: Performance issues are correctly diagnosed at the root-cause level, and recommendations resolve the actual problem.

Operational Excellence: Deliverables are completed on time, meet technical quality standards, and support a 95% or higher sprint completion rate.

Team Development: SEO Specialists improve in technical knowledge, crawl analysis, AI workflow use, and execution quality through coaching and feedback.

Quality Control: SEO work across assigned accounts is reviewed carefully, implemented correctly, and aligned with the Rocket Clicks methodology.

AI Workflow Impact: New AI workflows, skills, and processes are introduced that meaningfully improve speed, quality, or consistency of SEO execution.

Leadership & Collaboration: Positive feedback from SEO leadership, Account Managers, and cross-functional peers regarding technical depth, ownership, and clarity.





What It Takes To Succeed In This Role







To thrive as an Associate SEO Lead at Rocket Clicks, you should bring a balance of analytical ability, platform fluency, and accountability.



Advanced Technical SEO Expertise: Deep working knowledge of crawlability, indexation, rendering, semantic HTML, structured data, internal linking, site architecture, schema, redirects, canonicalization, page speed, and Core Web Vitals.

HTML & Site Structure Fluency: Ability to read and reason about HTML source, semantic markup, heading hierarchy, DOM structure, and how a site's architecture influences crawling, ranking, and user experience.

Crawl & Log Analysis: Proficiency with Screaming Frog, log file review, rendered DOM inspection, and equivalent crawl tools.

Local SEO Technical Knowledge: Working understanding of how to improve performance in competitive local markets through technical, on-page, and Google Business Profile execution.

Content Direction & Structure: Ability to brief, structure, optimize, and review SEO content for search intent, semantic depth, internal linking, and architectural placement within hub-and-spoke or cluster models.

AI Fluency & Workflow Building: Strong working command of modern AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and similar platforms, including prompt design, custom skill or workflow creation, and the ability to build AI-assisted processes that scale across a team.

Critical Thinking & Independent Problem Solving: Ability to investigate ambiguous problems, form a working hypothesis, run diagnostics, and resolve the issue without needing direction.

Quality Orientation: High standards for accuracy, structural soundness, and client-ready output.

Leadership Without Ego: Ability to mentor others, share knowledge, and give feedback without needing direct authority.

Communication: Ability to explain complex technical SEO issues in plain, practical language for internal teams, developers, and client-facing stakeholders.

Executional Discipline: Comfort managing multiple accounts, deadlines, dependencies, and sprint priorities without losing technical detail.

Curiosity & Adaptability: Ongoing investment in learning and testing as search, rendering, and AI continue to change.

Education 



Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.

SEO, analytics, or platform certifications are a plus, including Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.





Experience



4 to 7 years of professional SEO experience, preferably in an agency environment.

Proven track record of technical SEO execution that improved organic visibility, crawl health, indexation, rankings, leads, or local search performance.

Strong hands-on experience with technical SEO audits, implementation oversight, and complex troubleshooting.

Experience directing or reviewing SEO content production, including content briefs, structural guidance, on-page optimization, and internal linking within hub-and-spoke or cluster architectures.

Demonstrated experience using and building AI workflows in day-to-day SEO work, including prompt engineering, custom skill or workflow creation, and AI-assisted execution at scale.

Comfort reading HTML and identifying issues at the markup level, including ability to write specs, work alongside developers, and verify implementation.

 Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Google Business Profile, Screaming Frog, log file analyzers, SEMrush, Ahrefs, BrightLocal, Looker Studio, or similar platforms.

Experience working within WordPress or similar CMS environments, including familiarity with how themes, plugins, and template logic affect SEO output.

Prior experience in local SEO, legal marketing, family law, or service-based industries strongly preferred.

Experience mentoring junior team members or reviewing SEO work preferred.

Benefits



10 Paid Vacation Days per year

5 Paid Sick Days per year

10 Paid Company Holidays per year

Parental and bereavement leave

Performance bonus plan

This role is ground zero for something bigger:



- **You're the backbone of Ironbooks' operations.** Every client win flows through the work you do. You're not hidden in the back office—your work directly drives revenue, client retention, and company reputation.

- **You're scaling a system, not just doing work.** Right now, you're learning. In 6 months, you're training others. In 12 months, you're leading a team and working with our CEO on process improvement. This grows with you.



- **You're part of the Painter Growth ecosystem.** Ironbooks isn't standalone—it's the operational proof point for Painter Growth's AI positioning across the trades. Your work is literally the case study we use to sell coaching and other services. High visibility. Real leverage.



---

**If you're the type who wants more than a job:**



- You'll see direct ROI on your effort. Ship a clean book ? client signs for annual contract ? you see the impact immediately.

- You're not a cost center. You're a revenue driver. That matters differently when you know it.

- You're learning a category-defining skill set: bookkeeping + AI automation + operational systems. That's not replaceable. That's your edge.

- There's a real path here. We're scaling. The people who prove themselves in the first 6 months aren't stuck in junior roles—they move into leadership, specialist tracks, or new ventures as we expand.

- You're working with founders who care about outcomes and speed, not politics. That changes everything about how work feels.



---



## The Reality



We're lean. We move fast. We don't tolerate slow thinking or excuses. But we also:



- Celebrate wins loudly (and mean it)

- Pay attention to people who deliver

- Build in public (you'll see how your work impacts the market)

- Actually promote from within

- **Month 2:** You're owning client relationships independently. You're proofing your own work, shipping reports, and starting to see patterns in what works.

By the end of 90 days, we know if you're the one who grows with us.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Instacoach

Instacoach helps baseball players train with purpose through structured workouts, coaching, and content from top college and professional players. We're looking for a creative Video Editor who can help us produce engaging social media content that drives attention, retention, and growth.



Position Overview

This role is responsible for editing short-form content across Instagram, TikTok, and
. You'll work directly with our team to turn raw footage into engaging, professional sports content that captures attention and keeps viewers watching.

We're looking for someone who understands modern content, can think creatively, and consistently delivers high-quality work. While turnaround time is important, quality, storytelling, and engagement are the top priorities.

This is a pure editing role. Social media strategy, posting, and account management will be handled internally.



Responsibilities

- Edit engaging short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Create professional sports-style edits using animations, transitions, motion graphics, and cinematic effects

- Use pacing, sound design, music syncing, and visual timing to maximize engagement and retention

- Add text overlays, captions, zooms, graphics, and motion effects that enhance storytelling

- Build compelling story flow using clips, B-roll, training footage, and product footage

- Create athlete highlights, workout montages, promotional videos, educational content, and app-focused content

- Learn the Instacoach platform and understand how the product works

- Incorporate app screen recordings, overlays, and product demonstrations into content when needed

- Collaborate directly with Brandon Stahlman on content direction, feedback, and revisions

- Maintain organized project files and meet turnaround deadlines

- Continuously bring creative ideas to improve content performance and quality



Requirements

- Experience editing short-form social media content

- Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and retention

- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software

- Experience editing sports, fitness, or training-related content preferred

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Strong communication skills and willingness to receive frequent feedback

- Must be available for recurring meetings and collaboration during Eastern Time business hours

- Motion graphics and animation experience is a major plus



Schedule & Expectations

- Approximately 20 hours per week

- Attend a 30-minute standup meeting 4–5 mornings per week (EST)

- Work closely with the manager

- Learn the product, audience, and content strategy to create more effective edits

- Complete assigned deliverables outside of meeting times

- Maintain consistent communication regarding project status and deadlines

- Be proactive in identifying ways to improve content performance



Examples of Desired Editing Style

- Applicants will be provided with reference videos that represent the level of quality, pacing, creativity, transitions, animations, and storytelling we expect from our editors.



Hiring Process

- Qualified applicants will complete a short editing assessment using the provided footage and assets.



The assessment will evaluate:

- Editing quality

- Storytelling ability

- Transition usage

- Text and animation implementation

- Sound design and pacing

- Creative decision-making

- Overall content retention potential



Success in This Role

The ideal editor is not just someone who can cut clips together. They understand what makes content perform, communicate effectively, take ownership of their work, and consistently create content that helps Instacoach grow.

If you're passionate about sports content, understand modern social media editing, and enjoy turning raw footage into engaging stories, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Freelance News Writer – Entertainment website (Videogames, LEGO and tech)
description:
Hey!

We are looking for a dedicated freelance news writer for a European website who can produce daily news articles about LEGO, videogames and/or tech. 



We are seeking someone who can deliver 3 news articles per day from Monday through Friday. The focus is on current, relevant, and factually accurate news. 

Each news article should take no longer than 30 minutes to write. We also expect you to upload the finished articles neatly and independently to our admin system (you van use chatgpt to tanslate to our language

3 dollars per article

This equals approximately 180 dollars per month

This is a starting salary. With strong performance, platform growth, and a long-term collaboration, compensation can increase over time.

• Has a strong affinity with videogames, LEGO and tech, and understands the industry

• Can write 3 news articles per day from Monday to Friday

• Can complete each article within approximately 30 minutes

• Has a distinctive and engaging writing style

• Produces factually accurate articles and conducts proper research

• Has basic knowledge of SEO, including headings, keywords, and readability

• Can upload articles independently and correctly into our admin system

• Meets deadlines consistently

The articles must be suitable for an international audience and ready for professional publication on a news platform.

• A consistent monthly collaboration

• Growth opportunities based on performance

• The chance to grow in our team

• Potential expansion into interviews, feature articles, or special reports





Application

Interested?

Please send:

• 2 to 3 examples of previously written articles, preferably in English

• A short explanation of your experience with LEGO, videogames and/or tech 

• Any SEO experience you may have

• Your availability

• Your connection to or history with LEGO, videogames and/or tech

If you have read this entire job description, tell us what your favorite videogame or LEGO build is and why.

We look forward to building a long-term collaboration with someone who truly has a passion for entertainemnt and values quality

* And let us know what you prefer most (LEGO, videogames or tech)

title: Remote Copywriter (Webinar Presentations)
description:
If you enjoy building high-converting webinar presentations, following a clear, systematic process, and using AI to scale your writing, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring a Remote Webinar Copywriter to help us build high-converting presentations for our clients. The job is creative but systematic: you don't invent decks from scratch; you adapt a proven structure to each client. Your focus is strictly on the text/copy—the words on each slide. You are not designing anything. We do this work using Claude AI, so the whole build runs as a guided process inside a Claude project.



What you’ll do:

- Run guided AI workflows

- Adapt proven structures

- Manage slide tiers

- Define key variables

- Perfect the pacing

- You are not designing



What we provide:

- Detailed client intake forms containing all the raw material you need.

- Structural wireframes (marked with evergreen and near-evergreen identifiers) to act as your map.

- Starter prompts to load into Claude AI to initiate the build smoothly.

- Examples of high-converting presentations to reference for pacing and structural adaptation.



You’re a fit if:

- You know when to write fresh copy and when to leave proven "evergreen" assets alone.

- You understand how to pace a presentation for speaking, using sentence fragments rather than paragraphs.

- You have excellent editorial judgment and can synthesize a client's core promise into a highly effective opening "Hook."

- You enjoy directing and refining AI outputs rather than writing every single word from a blank page.



Requirements:

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, specifically for spoken presentations or webinars.

Comfortable operating workflows within AI platforms like Claude.

Available for team communication and questions between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM German time (your actual working hours are flexible).

Strong written and spoken English.

Reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.



How to apply: 

This is a short form where we ask about your experience, portfolio (please include copywriting or presentation examples), and availability.



If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we’ll offer you an assessment task to test how you run our Claude workflow.



Top candidates from the assessment task will be invited to a short 1:1 call and a paid trial period.



Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote

title: 7 Figure Business Ad Creative Editor (Needed for Script Execution)
description:
We run a high-volume direct response operation and need an editor who genuinely understands how DR ads work — not just someone who makes things look good, but someone who edits with the sell in mind.

This is a long-term role. If you're the right fit, you'll have consistent weekly work and room to grow with us.



What You'll Be Doing

Editing raw footage into high-converting ad creatives that run on Meta 
/Instagram). You will receive scripts — no B-roll guidance, no asset folders, no hand-holding. Sourcing the right supporting content is entirely on you. This is one of the most important parts of the job and how we separate good editors from great ones. Your edits need to serve the argument, not just fill the screen.



As you grow into the role, you'll also be expected to learn and execute AI-generated talking head creatives and to use AI video B-roll generators to source and create supporting footage. We'll walk you through our process, but you need to come in already comfortable with AI tools — and curious and coachable enough to push them further.



Who We're Looking For

You've edited paid ad creatives before — not just YouTube or social content, but ads built to convert

You understand why B-roll choices matter in DR — you're reinforcing belief, not decorating

You can explain why an edit works, not just execute it

You're resourceful with content sourcing — stock footage, B-roll libraries, sound design, you know where to find what you need without being pointed to it

You're open to learning new workflows, specifically AI talking head creative production

You're fast, reliable, and don't need to be chased for deliverables

You take feedback well and bring ideas to the table

You're honest about your skill level and won't waste either of our time

Comfortable with tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar

You already have hands-on skills with AI tools and know how to fold them into a real editing workflow

You can use AI video B-roll generators to create supporting footage that reinforces the sell — not just generic filler



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

We don't do traditional applications. This is a trial-based hiring process — we care about what you can do, not what your resume says.

Step 1 — Send us a message and include the word GOAT so we know you actually read this post. We'll send you a creative brief.

Step 2 — Using the brief, create a trial ad. This is your audition. Show us what you can do — and how fast you can do it. Speed and quality both matter.

Step 3 — If your trial submission is approved, we'll schedule an interview to discuss the role, pay structure, and next steps.

title: Remote Copywriter (Presentation & Webinar Scripts)
description:
If you enjoy building high-converting webinar presentations, following a clear, systematic process, and using AI to scale your writing, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring a Remote Webinar Copywriter to help us build high-converting presentations for our clients. The job is creative but systematic: you don't invent decks from scratch; you adapt a proven structure to each client. Your focus is strictly on the text/copy—the words on each slide. You are not designing anything. We do this work using Claude AI, so the whole build runs as a guided process inside a Claude project.



What you’ll do:

- Run guided AI workflows

- Adapt proven structures

- Manage slide tiers

- Define key variables

- Perfect the pacing

- You are not designing



What we provide:

- Detailed client intake forms containing all the raw material you need.

- Structural wireframes (marked with evergreen and near-evergreen identifiers) to act as your map.

- Starter prompts to load into Claude AI to initiate the build smoothly.

- Examples of high-converting presentations to reference for pacing and structural adaptation.



You’re a fit if:

- You know when to write fresh copy and when to leave proven "evergreen" assets alone.

- You understand how to pace a presentation for speaking, using sentence fragments rather than paragraphs.

- You have excellent editorial judgment and can synthesize a client's core promise into a highly effective opening "Hook."

- You enjoy directing and refining AI outputs rather than writing every single word from a blank page.



Requirements:

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, specifically for spoken presentations or webinars.

Comfortable operating workflows within AI platforms like Claude.

Available for team communication and questions between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM German time (your actual working hours are flexible).

Strong written and spoken English.

Reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.



How to apply: 

This is a short form where we ask about your experience, portfolio (please include copywriting or presentation examples), and availability.



If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we’ll offer you an assessment task to test how you run our Claude workflow.



Top candidates from the assessment task will be invited to a short 1:1 call and a paid trial period.



Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote

title: Creative Writer – Help Men Create Irresistible Dating Profiles
description:
Help Men Meet and Attract Their Dream Girl 



We're looking for a talented creative writer to help transform ordinary dating profiles into profiles that women genuinely want to swipe right on.



This is not traditional copywriting.



You won't be writing ads, blogs, or sales pages.



Instead, you'll be crafting Tinder, Bumble, and Hinge bios and prompts that make men appear more attractive, interesting, authentic, and memorable. Your writing should create curiosity, spark conversations, and make it easy for women to send the first message.



What You'll Be Doing



For each client, you'll receive information such as:



Photos

Lifestyle details

Hobbies and interests

Personality traits

Dating goals

Existing profile information



Using that information, you'll create:



Tinder/Bumble bios

Hinge prompts



Your goal is to turn a client's personality into a profile that stands out in a sea of generic dating profiles.



What We're Looking For



You might be a great fit if you:



Have exceptional creative writing skills. You can write like the written content/books that women love to read, such as romance novels or Wattpad.

Understand attraction and human psychology

Know what makes someone interesting and memorable

Can write in different tones and personalities

Have experience with dating apps (especially Tinder, Bumble, or Hinge)

Understand what catches attention and starts conversations

Can make someone's profile feel authentic rather than scripted. The bio and prompts should have a human "soul" into it. Should not just feel purely AI generated. 





You do NOT need professional copywriting experience if you're naturally talented at writing engaging, attractive, and conversational content.



Bonus Points If You:

Have experience writing dating profiles

Have worked in marketing, copywriting, journalism, or content creation

Have a strong understanding of modern dating culture

Have a background in psychology, communication, or storytelling

Have successfully helped friends improve their dating profiles



What Success Looks Like



The profiles you write should:



Generate more matches

Create genuine curiosity

Encourage women to start conversations

Make clients feel authentic and confident

Stand out from the typical boring dating profile



Position Details

Remote

Casual/Flexible hours

Work from anywhere

Ongoing work available for the right person

Paid per profile or hourly (depending on experience)



How To Apply



Please send:



A brief introduction about yourself

Any relevant writing samples

Your experience with dating apps (if applicable)



Follow these steps:

1. Open our Fulfillment Team Tracker: 

2. Pick one of our clients. Using the information the clients provided about themselves, write a Tinder/Bumble bio and 3 Hinge prompts. (If the client did not provide relevant info, just make up one.) The three Hinge prompts should start with...

                 1. "Together we could... "*insert here the romantic date idea. Be very specific about the details on the date (eg. location, what you're doing during the date) and use vivid imagery to make them visualise what it's like to go on a date with our male client. For example, "Together we could...watch the sunset over a glass of wine at the beach, and talk about our biggest dreams and fears." 

                 2. My humble brag is/My greatest strength is.. *insert here what they are good at. Ideally, it would be something that could be related to the girl. For example, if a client works in sales, you can say "My humble brag is...I can convince you do whatever I want ;)". Another example: "My humble brag is...I'm essentially an expert in female psychology. "

                 3. The way to win me over is/Win me over by... *insert here a quality (that is not about her looks) that the client wants from his dream girl. The purpose of this prompt is to convey that he has standards, that he won't be satisfied with just any random girl, and to make the woman qualify or prove that she, in fact, possesses the qualities he desires. For example... "The way to win me over is...being able to cook me a nice ribeye with a cheeky kiss on the cheek."  



The prompts should be fun, flirty, playful. It should focus on one key idea and elaborate on that one idea as opposed to listing different qualities. It should make the woman excited to get to know our male client and ideally make them want to go out with them on a date. Avoid generic lines, clichés, and recycled dating-app tropes.



We're looking for someone who genuinely understands people, attraction, and storytelling—not someone who simply writes well.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

This is not a general virtual assistant position. We need someone with real automotive repair shop estimating experience who understands how to build complete, accurate repair orders inside Tekmetric for advisor review.



We work Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST. This position requires someone willing to work our business hours, which will likely be a PHP graveyard shift. During scheduled work hours, you must be exclusively available to our shop.



Prior automotive repair shop estimating experience is required. Diesel and light/medium-duty vehicle experience is strongly preferred.



Compensation will include a smaller base pay plus performance bonus opportunities based on accuracy, efficiency, completed estimates, parts profitability, and reducing missed parts that hurt gross profit.

* Build full draft repair orders inside Tekmetric for service advisor review

* Research and add all required parts for recommended repairs

* Review repair procedures using ALLDATA, Identifix, OEM information, MOTOR, and Tekmetric canned jobs

* Identify one-time-use and non-reusable parts such as torque-to-yield bolts, seals, gaskets, clips, hardware, and other required replacement items

* Add commonly missed parts such as O-rings, fluids, filters, clamps, shop supplies, seals, gaskets, and related components

* Research parts using OEC RepairLink, PartsTech, ATD, TireHub, TireCo, and vendor catalogs

* Communicate with vendors by message or phone when needed to get answers quickly

* Ask technicians for clarification when repair recommendations are unclear

* Build complete, profitable, sellable tickets that help advisors present the job confidently

* Check availability, pricing, fitment, part numbers, and delivery options

* Compare OEM, aftermarket, and tire options when appropriate

* Help prevent missed parts, wrong parts, underpriced tickets, and profit leaks

* Document notes clearly inside Tekmetric

* Follow internal estimating procedures and shop standards

* Assist with back-office estimating and parts-related tasks as needed



Experience Required:



* Prior automotive repair shop estimating experience

* Experience building repair orders or estimates for service advisors

* Strong understanding of gas and diesel light/medium-duty vehicles

* Ability to read repair procedures and identify required supporting parts

* Familiarity with fluids, seals, gaskets, hardware, torque-to-yield bolts, and non-reusable components

* Ability to spot parts that are commonly forgotten but required to complete the job correctly

* Experience with Tekmetric preferred

* Experience with OEC RepairLink, PartsTech, ATD, TireHub, TireCo, ALLDATA, Identifix, OEM repair information, and MOTOR preferred

* Strong English reading and writing skills required

* Clear spoken English preferred for vendor calls and team communication

* Will require video interviews

* Must be fluent in English reading and writing

title: Senior Medical Biller / RCM Specialist - eClinicalWorks Required - Pain Management & Workers’ Comp
description:
Genesis Pain Clinic is a US-based interventional pain management practice looking for a full-time Senior Medical Biller / Revenue Cycle Management Specialist.



Schedule:

Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM US Central Time

40 hours per week

Full-time, dedicated role



Pay:

$7-$11 USD per hour, depending on verified experience



This is a hands-on provider-side medical billing role. We are looking for someone who already has real US medical billing experience and can work independently inside eClinicalWorks.



This is not a general VA role.

This is not an entry-level billing role.

This is not a flexible-hours or part-time role.



The right person should be able to review claims, identify billing problems, work denials, follow up with payers, document clearly, and keep the revenue cycle moving without needing constant step-by-step instructions.



--------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



- Minimum 3 to 5 years of US medical billing / RCM experience

- Hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience required

- Provider-side outpatient clinic billing experience preferred

- Experience with claim submission, claim scrubbing, payment posting, manual posting, denials, appeals, reconsiderations, and AR follow-up

- Comfortable using payer portals and calling insurance companies

- Comfortable with CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, units, place of service, and authorization requirements

- Able to document payer calls, reference numbers, claim notes, and next follow-up dates

- Able to work full-time during US Central Time business hours

- Reliable internet, backup internet, and backup power required



--------------------------------------------------

STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



- Pain management billing

- Interventional procedure billing

- Workers' Compensation billing

- Orthopedic, spine, neurology, PM&R, or specialty billing

- Medicare, Medicare Advantage, commercial insurance, and out-of-network billing

- Prior authorizations for procedures

- Medical necessity appeals

- Payment posting and underpayment review

- Coding certification or strong coding knowledge



--------------------------------------------------

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

--------------------------------------------------



You should be able to independently handle most of the following:



- Verification of benefits / eligibility

- Prior authorization / pre-authorization

- Claim submission

- Claim scrubbing

- Clearinghouse rejection correction

- Payment posting from ERA/EOB

- Manual payment posting

- Contractual adjustments

- Denial management

- Corrected claims

- Appeals and reconsiderations

- AR follow-up

- Medical records requests

- Payer portal follow-up

- Workers' Compensation claim follow-up

- Daily productivity reporting



--------------------------------------------------

eCLINICALWORKS REQUIREMENT

--------------------------------------------------



Hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience is required.



Please do not apply if you only used eCW for scheduling, only watched eCW videos, or only have basic exposure. We need someone who understands the billing side of eCW.



You should be comfortable with eCW workflows such as:



- Claim review

- Claim submission

- Claim status

- Claim notes

- Payment posting

- Denial tracking

- Corrected claims

- AR follow-up

- Attaching or referencing payer documentation



--------------------------------------------------

PAIN MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



Pain management billing experience is a strong advantage.



Examples of procedures we may bill include:



- Epidural steroid injections

- Medial branch blocks

- Radiofrequency ablation

- SI joint injections

- Trigger point injections

- Large joint injections

- Fluoroscopy-guided procedures

- Ultrasound-guided procedures

- Urine drug testing



You do not need to know every pain procedure on day one, but you must be comfortable learning payer rules, CPT/modifier issues, authorization requirements, and documentation requirements.



--------------------------------------------------

WORKERS' COMPENSATION

--------------------------------------------------



Workers' Compensation billing experience is strongly preferred.



Helpful experience includes:



- Claim numbers

- Date of injury

- Adjusters

- Nurse case managers

- Authorizations

- EOR/EOB review

- Records requests

- Underpayment follow-up

- Reconsiderations

- Appeals

- Payer-specific Workers' Compensation processes



--------------------------------------------------

FULL-TIME DEDICATED ROLE / NO OVEREMPLOYMENT

--------------------------------------------------



This is a full-time dedicated role during our scheduled work hours.



During paid working hours, you may not:



- Work for another client

- Work for another agency

- Work another job

- Monitor another client's messages

- Keep another work laptop open

- Attend another client's meetings

- Run another time tracker

- Subcontract your work

- Share logins



Before hire, you must disclose all current clients, employers, agencies, freelance work, and recurring paid obligations.



Another job that overlaps with 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time is disqualifying.



This role is not compatible with overemployment, double-jobbing, mouse jigglers, fake activity, or time padding.



--------------------------------------------------

TIME TRACKING AND COMMUNICATION

--------------------------------------------------



Time Doctor will be required.



We may review:



- Screenshots

- Activity levels

- App usage

- Website usage

- eCW activity

- Payer portal activity

- Teams responsiveness

- Daily output reports



Time Doctor activity alone is not enough. Paid time must match real billing output.



Manual time is not allowed unless approved.



During scheduled hours, you must be reachable on Microsoft Teams. Normal response expectation is within 5 minutes unless you are on a payer call, in a meeting, or have already documented why you are unavailable.



--------------------------------------------------

DAILY REPORTING

--------------------------------------------------



At the end of each workday, you will send a short productivity report showing what was completed, what is pending, and what is blocked.



Your report may include:



- Claims submitted

- Claims corrected

- Denials worked

- Appeals or reconsiderations submitted

- Payments posted

- Manual payments posted

- AR accounts worked

- Prior authorizations submitted or followed up

- VOBs completed

- Payer calls completed

- Reference numbers obtained

- Issues needing provider or administrator review



--------------------------------------------------

SELECTION PROCESS

--------------------------------------------------



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete:



- Written screening questions

- Short video interview

- Live eClinicalWorks / RCM technical interview

- Live screen-share workflow test

- Paid practical billing test

- 5-day paid evaluation period

- 30-day probationary period



We are not hiring based only on interview confidence. We are hiring based on demonstrated skill, reliability, integrity, and actual work output.



--------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------------------



Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions.



The first line of your application must be:



ECW RCM DEDICATED



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years of US provider-side medical billing / RCM experience do you have? Which specialties have you billed for?



2. How many years of hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience do you have? List the exact billing tasks you personally performed inside eCW.



3. Which RCM tasks can you perform independently?

Examples: VOB, prior auth, claim submission, claim scrubbing, payment posting, manual posting, denial management, appeals, AR follow-up, records requests.



4. Describe a denial you fixed from start to finish. What was the denial, what did you check, what action did you take, and how did you document it?



5. Explain your payment posting experience. Have you posted ERAs/EOBs and manual payments? Have you identified underpayments, duplicate posting, contractual adjustments, or recoupments?



6. Describe your Workers' Compensation billing experience, if any.



7. Which payer portals and clearinghouse portals have you personally used?

Examples: Availity, UHC, Optum, Medicare, Medicaid, BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, Workers' Compensation portals, TriZetto, Office Ally, or other clearinghouses.



8. Are you currently working for any other client, employer, agency, or freelance project? If yes, list your exact schedule and whether it overlaps with 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time.



9. Confirm that you are comfortable with Time Doctor, screenshots, activity tracking, daily productivity reports, Teams responsiveness, and live screen-sharing when requested.



10. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



Mini Test Question:



A claim for a lumbar radiofrequency ablation is denied for CO-50, medical necessity. Walk me through what you would check before d
 whether to submit an appeal, corrected claim, or records request.

If you do great work on this first project, you will be working on all our future brands as well. We are looking for someone to grow with us long term.



What you'll work on



Build and customize our Shopify store (theme Dawn)

Implement design changes based on our brand guidelines

Fix CSS, HTML and Liquid code

Maintain visual consistency across all pages (homepage, product pages, cart, checkout)

Set up apps and integrations when needed

Eventually work on new brand projects as we scale

Strong experience with Shopify and Dawn theme customization

Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, Liquid (Shopify templating language)

An eye for design — you must understand branding and visual consistency

Ability to follow precise instructions without improvising

Attention to detail — one wrong color or wrong font ruins everything

Good written English to communicate clearly

Reliability — we need someone we can count on every day

Someone who will use generic solutions that don't match the brand

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer



Wandering Lion is a brand and growth agency that helps founder-led businesses build stronger foundations, clearer messaging, and integrated growth systems. We work across brand, strategy, marketing, websites, campaigns, and ongoing growth support, creating work for both our own businesses and a range of client brands.



We’re looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can produce polished, commercially focused creative work across brand, digital, social, web, and marketing channels.



This role is for someone who understands that strong design is not just about making things look good. It’s about building trust, improving brand perception, creating consistency, and supporting real business outcomes.



You’ll need to be confident working from existing brand guides, style guides, campaign directions, templates, and supplied assets, and turning them into high-quality finished creative without needing excessive hand-holding. You should also be capable of helping create brand guides, style guides, design templates, and visual systems for new clients when required.

Strong experience with Adobe Creative Cloud is essential, especially Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Experience with Premiere Pro, Light Room, After Effects, Figma, Canva, Webflow, or WordPress would also be highly regarded.



Key Responsibilities

- Create graphics, marketing assets, social media content, presentations, digital documents, and campaign visuals

- Work from supplied brand guides, style guides, templates, and creative directions

- Use Adobe Creative Cloud to create, edit, retouch, prepare, and export professional design assets

- Design assets for social media, paid ads,
 campaigns, websites, landing pages, and proposals

- Retouch, crop, resize, optimise, and prepare images for digital and marketing use

- Maintain strong brand consistency across multiple businesses and client accounts

- Check work carefully for spacing, alignment, spelling, formatting, export settings, and brand accuracy

- Manage multiple creative tasks, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines



What We’re Looking For

- Strong graphic design portfolio

- Advanced experience with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign

- Experience working with brand guides, style guides, and visual identity systems

- Strong understanding of layout, typography, spacing, colour, hierarchy, and composition

- Experience creating digital, social, web, campaign, and presentation assets

- High attention to detail and pride in polished execution

- Ability to follow direction while bringing thoughtful creative input

- Reliable, organised, proactive, and comfortable working remotely

- Good communication and collaboration skills



Preferred Experience

- Website graphic design or landing page design

- Video editing or motion graphics

- Canva template creation

- Figma, Webflow, or WordPress support

- Proposal, presentation, or report design

The Type of Person We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is reliable, honest, detail-focused, easy to work with, and open to feedback.

We’re looking for someone who can bring creative ideas and visual thinking to the table, but who also understands when the job requires following an existing brand direction, maintaining consistency, and producing commercially useful work rather than pushing their own personal style.

title: Paid Ads Specialist (Google & Meta)
description:
Paid Ads Specialist (GooJob Title: Performance Marketing Manager

 Location: Remote

 Job Type: Full-time

About Wandering Lion

Wandering Lion is a strategy-led growth studio helping founder-led businesses build premium brands, install scalable growth systems, and generate measurable commercial outcomes — without chaos. We do not sell marketing activity for the sake of it. We build structured growth systems that connect brand, performance, systems, and reporting to real business results.

Our model is disciplined: foundation first, then build, then scale. That means we care deeply about clarity, accountability, and making sure paid media works inside a stronger commercial system — not in isolation.

The Role

We are looking for a commercially sharp Performance Marketing Manager to lead campaign execution, optimisation, and channel development across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other current or emerging paid acquisition platforms.

This role is not limited to today’s core channels. As the business grows, this position may also support expansion into additional advertising ecosystems, marketing technology, AI-enabled tools, automation platforms, and other digital growth systems that improve performance, reporting, and operational efficiency.

This is not a button-pushing media buying role. We want someone who understands that ads amplify clarity — they do not create it — and who can help translate strategy into efficient, measurable growth.

You will work across founder-led brands that need more than clicks and impressions. They need disciplined media execution, better conversion performance, clearer reporting, and someone who understands the commercial outcome behind the spend. Our ideal clients value structure, proof, and accountability, so your work must reflect that standard.

Key Responsibilities

Paid media strategy and planning

 Build channel strategies across Google, Meta, and other relevant paid platforms based on client goals, audience behaviour, customer journey stage, and conversion priorities.

Campaign setup and execution

 Launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across search, display, remarketing, paid social, and future paid channels where appropriate.

Audience, keyword, and market research

 Conduct keyword research, audience segmentation, competitor review, and targeting refinement to improve efficiency and lead quality.

Creative and messaging alignment

 Work closely with strategy and creative to ensure ad messaging reflects the brand, strengthens trust, and supports conversion.

Testing and optimisation

 Run structured tests across headlines, copy, creative, offers, landing pages, audience segments, and funnel stages to improve performance over time.

Budget and bid management

 Allocate spend carefully, adjust bids based on performance, and manage budgets with commercial discipline.

Performance reporting

 Translate campaign and funnel data into clear reporting that explains what happened, what it means, and what we do next.

Technology and AI adoption

 Help identify and implement useful tools, AI software, automation workflows, and platform enhancements that improve campaign performance, efficiency, internal reporting, or client delivery.

Conversion and systems thinking

 Monitor lead quality, conversion paths, attribution, and funnel performance — not just platfor
trics — to support real business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts with measurable results

Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, attribution, conversion tracking, and optimisation

Confidence learning and adapting to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and digital systems as the role evolves

Ability to think beyond platfor
trics and connect spend to commercial outcomes

Strong communication skills and the ability to explain performance clearly

A structured, accountable, detail-driven approach to campaign management

Comfort working in a business that values quality over volume and clarity over noise

Preferred

Experience across service-based businesses, eCommerce, trades, or founder-led brands

Familiarity with landing page optimisation and CRO principles

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations

Google Ads certifications

Meta advertising certifications

Experience using CRM, analytics, and reporting platforms

What Success Looks Like in This Role

Campaigns are well-structured, well-managed, and commercially aligned

Reporting is clear, useful, and trusted by clients

Paid media performance improves through disciplined testing and optimisation

Useful tools and systems are introduced where they genuinely improve efficiency or outcomes

Clients feel confident that spend is being managed with accountability

You contribute to a premium client experience, not just campaign delivery

Why Join Wandering Lion

You’ll be joining a business built around calm authority, commercial clarity, and human confidence. We are not trying to become a high-volume agency. We are building a quality-protected growth studio that integrates brand, performance, and systems under one roof.

That means:

You’ll work on higher-quality engagements

You’ll be part of a strategy-led model, not random execution

You’ll collaborate with a team that values standards, structure, and outcomes

You’ll help build growth systems that genuinely move businesses forward

Before We Proceed

Before we potentially move to the interview stage, we’d like to gather a few details to make sure the role is a strong fit and that you’ll be set up for success working remotely with our team.

1. PC / Laptop specifications + internet speed

 Please share your device specifications, including CPU, RAM, and storage, along with a recent internet speed test result. Reliable performance and strong internet are essential for day-to-day work.

2. Current employment or side work

 Are you currently employed or doing any freelance or side work? We are open to offshore tea
mbers having multiple roles. What matters most to us is transparency, so we understand your typical schedule and can support you properly.

3. Hubstaff tracker

 Are you comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking? Our whole team operates remotely, including our field and admin staff in Australia. Hubstaff helps us understand time allocation across projects, improve internal reporting, and provide clearer updates to clients.

4. Working hours / availability

 Can you commit to the required hours? Our standard workdays are Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm Philippines time. We offer reasonable flexibility — family and life come first — but we do need consistency and clear communication.

5. Expected salary (PHP)

 If this differs from what was listed in the advert, please confirm your expected salary in PHP.

6. CV / Resume

 Please attach your CV if you have not already done so.

7. Relevant training / courses

 Please include any relevant training, certifications, or courses you have completed.

8. English level

 Please confirm your English level (C1 or C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.

Team Context

For context, we currently have a team of 10 people in the Philippines, all working from home, and we are continuing to grow. We value honesty, transparency, and teamwork. We are looking for people who are humble, reliable, and easy to work with — because every role matters, and the most important thing is a happy team doing work they enjoy, surrounded by like-minded people.

How to Apply

Please send your CV, a short introduction, and responses to the questions above, along with 2–3 examples of accounts, campaigns, platforms, or systems you have worked on and the commercial outcomes achieved.

Thank you. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: META ADS MEDIA BUYER/ STRATEGIST
description:
Do not apply unless you have maximum confidence in your ability to deliver results. We will ask for proof.



Ensure you read the whole description.



Media Buyer — Meta Ads Specialist

Reports to: Head of Growth / Marketing Director

Full-time | Performance Marketing | Paid Social



About the role

We're looking for a results-driven, high-performance Media Buyer who lives and breathes Meta advertising. You've managed substantial budgets, know how to scale without blowing ROAS, and can back everything up with hard data. If you've turned paid social into a predictable growth engine, we want to talk.



At a glance



Minimum ROAS: 3.0+

Monthly spend managed: $10k+

Experience required: 2+ years Meta Ads

Track record: Proven ability to scale





Key responsibilities



Own end-to-end campaign management across Meta Ads Manager — from strategy and build to optimisation and reporting, across multiple accounts simultaneously.

Strategically scale ad spend — increasing budgets and expanding audiences while maintaining a minimum 3.0 ROAS, using proven budget-pacing and bid management techniques.

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers — building a clear testing log and acting on results with speed.

Brief and collaborate with the creative team to produce high-converting ad assets — you understand what makes a Meta ad stop the scroll and drive conversions, and you can communicate that clearly.

Monitor account health daily — diagnosing performance drops, frequency issues, audience fatigue, and delivery problems before they impact results.

Build and manage full-funnel campaign structures — prospecting (TOF), retargeting (MOF/BOF), and retention — with a clear understanding of how each layer interacts.

Set up and maintain accurate tracking — Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), custom events, and UTM parameters — ensuring data integrity across all campaigns.

Deliver clear weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights — no vanity metrics, just ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and the story they tell.

Stay ahead of Meta platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats — proactively adapting strategy before performance is affected.





What we require



Proven spend experience: you must have personally managed Meta ad accounts at $10k+ monthly spend. You'll be asked to provide account-level results, not agency-level attribution.

Demonstrated ROAS performance: a consistent track record of sustaining 3.0+ ROAS at scale. You must be able to show this with real data.

Deep Meta Ads Manager expertise: campaign objective selection, CBO vs ABO strategy, Advantage+ campaigns, broad vs interest targeting, lookalike audiences, and manual vs automated bidding.

Scaling methodology: you have a clear, repeatable process for scaling budgets — whether through horizontal expansion, budget multipliers, or audience diversification — without destabilising campaigns.

Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with GA4, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar attribution tools. You don't just read dashboards — you interrogate data to form hypotheses.

Tracking & measurement fluency: solid understanding of iOS 14+ attribution impact, CAPI implementation, and how to maintain reporting accuracy in a privacy-first landscape.

Creative instinct: you understand performance creative — hooks, UGC formats, video vs static — and can brief a team or give concrete, actionable feedback on ad assets.

Self-sufficient and accountable: you flag problems early, own outcomes, and don't wait for direction. You manage your accounts like they're your own business.





Nice to have



Experience running Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or YouTube alongside Meta as part of a blended paid strategy.

Experience in DTC / e-commerce environments where ROAS and blended MER are primary KPIs.

Shopify analytics experience and understanding of how paid social integrates with on-site conversion rate.

Experience managing multiple client accounts with varying spend levels, verticals, and objectives.

Meta Blueprint certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.





Interview process



Application review — Submit a brief summary of your highest-spend account, the ROAS achieved, and how you scaled it.

Intro call (30 min) — Walk us through your experience, biggest wins, and how you think about scaling.

Paid task / case study — A short paid exercise: audit a real or sample account and present your findings and action plan.

Final interview — Deep dive with the hiring manager. We'll go through your case study and align on strategy.





Important note

We take results seriously. During the process, you'll be expected to share real performance data (anonymised if needed) that validates your experience. Candidates who cannot demonstrate their ROAS track record with data will not progress

).

If you've made it this far and you're a real wholesaling cold caller, we want to hear from you. The first couple of days are a paid trial. Perform, and you have a long-term home with us.
